description: MailBackend::find_thread_by_message_ids has no default; it is required. But the warning on next_id() in email.rs is only in a comment, not enforced by the type system. The clock-seeded counter is explicitly documented as collision-prone across process restarts (common in containers). Any real backend must override find_thread_by_message_ids with durable thread lookup, but the only enforcement is documentation — no compile-time guard, no runtime panic. A contributor building a persistent backend without reading the full doc will silently corrupt thread graphs.
title: find_thread_by_message_ids default returns None — persistent backends generate collision-prone IDs
